text:
maya: quick note — two pilot customers paused Dedicated until we can show route-level economics and a compact error summary. need a narrow launch we can ship fast.

ton y: suggest a tiny ship: per-route cost table (last 24h), error-rate small multiples, and a "view trace" link for sampled requests. keep span analytics for follow-up. estimate ~3 dev days + 2 infra days.

ben: attribution question: can we piggyback on nightly batch attribution for now? if we accept ~10% variance for top routes we save a week.

sarah: customers want this to be stable for a week and a short runbook. also asked about a "cost impact" knob for batching as a demo. can be stretch.

ton y: sampling plan: sticky reservoir per route, sample rate tuned by qps buckets. i'll run a 48h spike to validate accuracy.

ben: infra needs an ephemeral validation pipeline and a small billing-tag change to surface route ids. ops said yes after ticket. i'll file it.

ops-bot: New ticket created: INF-834. Requester: ben. ETA approval: 24–48h.

maya: acceptance criteria proposal: (1) route cost within 10% of offline batch for high-volume routes; (2) error signal not noisy for 24h; (3) docs + runbook; (4) at least one customer signoff. owners: tony (impl), ben (infra), sarah (customer ops).

sarah: i'll schedule two 30m acceptance demos this week and draft pass/fail cases.

ton y: spike card up. if reuse works, full impl ~3d. otherwise add +4d.

maya: plan: shiplet-1 = cost table + error sparkline + trace-link (pilot beta). shiplet-2 = batching knob + sampling controls + error breakdown. target shiplet-1 in sprint 12. next sync Thu 9am. action items: tony (spike + impl), ben (infra ticket + ephemeral), sarah (cust demos), maya (docs + comms).

ben: adding board cards now.

maya: thanks all. :thumbsup:
